items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: And we'd do two or three albums in one session. ... He's got him, and couldn't read those scores, either

ctx.x: And we'd do two or three albums in one session. Now, you got this guy, (unintelligible).

He's got him, and couldn't read those scores, either, but this guy pretends to be a musician, and he can't read the scores. And he never comes out into the room to hear the sound of the music, musically.
